title: interactional-features-ja: quantifying interactional features of Japanese everyday conversation
description:
Reproducible pipeline for measuring 19 interactional features (speech timing, fillers, sequence organisation, response types) from Japanese everyday conversation, together with the validation analyses reported in the accompanying manuscript: Ridge regression with subject-wise GroupKFold, permutation tests, bootstrap coefficient stability, sensitivity analyses, confound control, and baseline conditions that test whether the language-model scores depend on the transcript content.

The CEJC corpus is not redistributed here. The identity of the text shown to the models is pinned by a SHA-256 digest recorded in the repository. See docs/data-availability.md.
